cohort: Human umbilical cord-derived mesenchymal stem cells (hUCMSCs) isolated and purified from the umbilical cords of normal or cesarean term deliveries.
finding: Human umbilical cord-derived mesenchymal stem cells (hUCMSCs) can be differentiated into myocardial cells in vitro by 5-azacytidine, with the DLL4-Notch signaling pathway potentially involved in this differentiation.
